## Methods


### _Platynereis dumerilii_ husbandry 
_Platynereis dumerilii_ cultures were maintained in artificial seawater at 18°C by Emily Savage. For spawning, mature adults were transferred into beakers, where the larvae were subsequently incubated at 18°C, respectivly. 

### Treatment with Cryopreservation Agents 
Prior to freezing, larvae were treated with a cryoprotectant solution containing 5% DMSO and 0.1% sucrose in artificial seawater. Larvae were incubated for at least 1 h before being transferred into microcapillary tubes or Eppendorf tubes for freezing.
